scope: Verified named leadership and structural offices in other SLI sectors. Not every candidate officeholder is established as current; unknown remains null. Functional adjacency does not imply ministerial command.

energy.note_id: Pimpinan ESDM adalah regulator; PLN, Pertamina, SKK Migas, BPH Migas dan DEN memiliki mandat terpisah.
energy.note_en: ESDM offices regulate; PLN, Pertamina, SKK Migas, BPH Migas and DEN have distinct mandates.

minerals.note_id: Regulasi tambang, kebijakan industri dan realisasi investasi berada di kementerian berbeda; MIND ID dan Danantara bukan dirjen.
minerals.note_en: Mining regulation, industrial policy and investment facilitation belong to distinct agencies; MIND ID and Danantara are not ministries.

ai.note_id: Kemkomdigi memimpin kebijakan digital, ESDM urusan listrik, BKPM fasilitasi penanaman modal. Hubungan lintas institusi fungsional.
ai.note_en: Komdigi leads digital policy, ESDM electricity governance and BKPM investment facilitation. Cross-agency links are functional.

food.note_id: Kementan adalah lembaga teknis pertanian; Bapanas dan BGN berdiri sendiri, meskipun terjadi rangkap jabatan.
food.note_en: Agriculture is the line ministry; Bapanas and BGN are distinct institutions despite concurrent appointments.

investment.note_id: Penanaman modal dan pengembangan industri merupakan otoritas pemerintah berbeda. Perusahaan adalah pelaksana, bukan unit eselon.
investment.note_en: Investment facilitation and industrial policy are distinct public authorities. Companies are implementers, not directorate-level offices.

macro.note_id: Bank Indonesia independen, tidak di bawah Bappenas atau Kemenkeu. BPS penyedia statistik, bukan pelaksana fiskal.
macro.note_en: Bank Indonesia is independent. BPS produces statistics; it does not execute fiscal policy.

policy.note_id: Ini jaringan pelaksana kebijakan relevan, bukan hierarki seluruh pembentuk regulasi; DPR, BPK dan lembaga peradilan tidak di bawah kementerian.
policy.note_en: Policy actors are not the entire lawmaking system; parliament, audit and courts are constitutionally distinct.

geo.note_id: Diplomasi, pertahanan dan administrasi dalam negeri adalah kementerian terpisah; TNI/Polri serta lembaga intelijen memiliki jalur kelembagaan tersendiri.
geo.note_en: Diplomacy, defense and domestic administration belong to distinct ministries; armed forces, police and intelligence agencies have separate reporting lines.

environment.note_id: BPLH, BMKG, BNPB, dan perencana pembangunan adalah lembaga dengan kewenangan berbeda; tidak ada garis komando lintas semuanya.
environment.note_en: BPLH, BMKG, BNPB and national planning exercise different statutory functions; this is not a universal command chart.

entities.note_id: Ini katalog jabatan publik, bukan struktur kepemilikan atau anak perusahaan.
entities.note_en: This public office directory is separate from company ownership structures.

provincial.note_id: Jajaran nasional bukan substitusi kepala dinas atau pemerintah daerah untuk 38 provinsi.
provincial.note_en: National agencies do not replace province-specific official rosters.

quality_policy.missing_person: null (not empty string, not incumbent from a prior cabinet)
quality_policy.source_provenance: every named incumbent has a government or government-agency official public source
quality_policy.officeholder_date: checked_on is evidence review date, not sworn-in date
quality_policy.sectors_overlap: shared agency record referenced by sectors, never duplicated
quality_policy.ministry_companies: SOEs and privately-owned operators are excluded from statutory ministries
quality_policy.agency_icons: neutral initials only unless an original official logo asset is reviewed
quality_policy.broad_coverage: this is an expansion of national ministry units and not an exhaustive inventory of every province, regional service office or rank II unit
quality_policy.official_sources_dated: An official 2025 appointment list does not automatically confirm the same incumbent in October 2026. Profile rows explicitly flag this uncertainty.
quality_policy.independent_agency_rule: Independent BI must not appear as an administrative subordinate; a shared national direction row is contextual.
quality_policy.disclosure: Scope expansion is a cited partial institutional roster, NOT a complete census of Indonesia's public sector.
quality_policy.coverage_note: The shared roster covers named sectors and selected ministries, agencies and institutions; it is not a complete civil-service census. Unknown roles are retained as null.
quality_policy.review_required: Official rosters for numerous internal directorates and independent bodies remain incomplete; do not present this registry as an exhaustive state organization chart.
quality_policy.scope_label: Expanding verified institutional sample · not exhaustive
quality_policy.branding: Display official agency web-site favicons as distinctly labelled site icons, not as authenticated statutory emblems; verified logo needs approved source asset.

audit_update.extra_validation: Kemlu named leaders backed by 2026 official government documents; Kemendagri senior officials backed by latest available ministry 2025-2026 reference.
